name: Finder Love Kudou Risa - First Shoot wa Kimi to.
original_name: ファインダーラブ 工藤里紗 ファーストショットは君と。
source:
You meet the girl on the beach and you begin taking photo's of her.
You are a freelance photographer.

You get caught and scolded by the girl and questioned.
She will try to attack you and in this mini game you have to 
block her advances.

You will be later questioned and if answered correctly.
She will continue and she will ask you for your name and 
she will give you hers.

[From [url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/psp/933321-finder-love-kudou-risa-first-shoot-wa-kimi-to/faqs/45283]Gamefaqs[/url]]
translation:
你在海滩上遇到了那个女孩，然后开始给她拍照。
你是一名自由摄影师。

你被女孩抓住并责骂并​​询问。
她会尝试攻击你，在这个游戏中你必须 
阻止她的进步。

稍后你将被询问，如果回答正确。
她会继续，她会问你的名字和 
她会给你她的。

[来自[url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/psp/933321-finder-love-kudou-risa-first-shoot-wa-kimi-to/faqs/45283]游戏常见问题解答[/url]]
